raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "napari-feature-classifier" %}
{% set version = "0.4.2" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name.replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3fb0256f14af9208733081a8f0c961ddfc5990b943550fbc613a83f3782710fb


build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
  run:
    - numpy
    - napari >=0.6.0
    - imageio
    - magicgui
    - matplotlib-base
    - pandas >=2.2.0,<3.0.0
    - pandera
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - python-xxhash
    - qtpy
    - scikit-learn >=1.2.2
    - typing_extensions

test:
  imports:
    - napari_feature_classifier
    - napari_feature_classifier.classifier_widget
  commands:
    - pip list
    # - pip check  # Failds due to hypothesis
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - pyqt
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/fractal-napari-plugins-collection/napari-feature-classifier
  summary: An interactive classifier plugin to use with label images and feature measurements
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jaimergp
    - jluethi
